# Getting help with Peek

For setup and usage, start with the [README](../README.md),
[CLI guide](../docs/CLI.md), and
[troubleshooting guide](../docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md).

Ask usage questions in [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/radityama/peek/discussions).
If you can reproduce a defect, open a [bug report](https://github.com/radityama/peek/issues/new/choose).
Keep logs and examples free of credentials, private URLs, and project data.

For a vulnerability, use [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/radityama/peek/security/advisories/new)
and read the [security guide](../docs/SECURITY.md).
